억.ex: 서울에서 아파트를 사려면 몇 억이 필요해요.
억.x: To buy an apartment in Seoul, you need several hundred million won.
억.e: The next big unit after 만: 10,000 × 10,000.

맡기다.m: to leave (in someone's care), to entrust; to assign
맡기다.ex: 여행 가는 동안 강아지를 친구에게 맡겼어요.
맡기다.x: I left my puppy with a friend while I was traveling.
맡기다.e: Causative of 맡다 'to take charge of': make someone take charge.
맡기다.t: Pronounced [맏끼다]; hotels use it for luggage: 짐을 맡길 수 있어요?

뵙다.forms: 뵙겠습니다 · 뵙고 · vowel endings use 뵈다: 봬요 · 뵀어요 · 뵐게요
뵙다.m: to see, to meet (humble, someone senior)
뵙다.x: Professor, I'll come and see you next week.
뵙다.e: Humble verb: you lower yourself when meeting someone higher in status. Before vowel endings it switches to 뵈다 (뵈어요 → 봬요).
뵙다.t: Pronounced [뵙따]: 다 turns tense after ㅂ. The plain words are 보다 and 만나다; use 뵙다 for meeting teachers, bosses or elders, as in 처음 뵙겠습니다 'Nice to meet you'.

통과하다.m: to pass through; to pass (a test, a bill)
통과하다.ex: 저는 한 번에 운전면허 시험에 통과했어요.
통과하다.x: I passed my driver's license test on the first try.
통과하다.t: Both 시험에 통과하다 and 시험을 통과하다 are common; 합격하다 is the standard word for passing exams.

축의금.x: I went to my friend's wedding and gave a cash gift.
축의금.t: Pronounced [추기금]; put cash in a white envelope and hand it in at the reception desk.

효과적.ex: 단어를 외우는 효과적인 방법을 알려 주세요.
효과적.x: Please tell me an effective way to memorize words.

합치다.ex: 학생이 적어서 두 반을 합쳐서 수업했어요.
합치다.x: There weren't many students, so we combined the two classes.

정가.x: They sell this book 10% below the list price.

공고.x: A job posting went up on the company website.

죽마고우.ex: 민수는 저의 죽마고우라서 서로 모르는 게 없어요.
죽마고우.x: Minsu is my childhood friend, so we know everything about each other.
죽마고우.e: Literally 'an old friend from riding bamboo horses' together as kids.
죽마고우.t: Pronounced [중마고우] — nasalization of ㄱ before ㅁ.

곤두박질치다.m: to nosedive, to plummet; to fall headfirst
곤두박질치다.x: As the economy worsened, exports nosedived.
곤두박질치다.e: From 곤두박질 'a headfirst tumble' plus 치다; pictures falling upside down.
곤두박질치다.t: Vivid and informal-sounding, yet very common in news headlines about prices and ratings.

통.m: (with a negative) not at all, at all
통.ex: 요즘 입맛이 없어서 밥을 통 못 먹어요.
통.x: I have no appetite these days, so I can't eat at all.
통.e: Homonym warning: 통 also means 'barrel, container'.
통.t: Casual and spoken; 전혀 is the neutral equivalent.

흘끗.ex: 그는 시계를 흘끗 보고 다시 일을 했어요.
흘끗.x: He glanced at his watch and went back to work.
흘끗.e: A mimetic word; 힐끗 is a near-identical variant.

맥이 빠지다.forms: 맥이 빠져요 · 맥이 빠졌어요 · 맥 빠지는 + noun
맥이 빠지다.m: to feel deflated; to lose heart; to be drained
맥이 빠지다.ex: 열심히 준비한 행사가 취소돼서 맥이 빠졌어요.
맥이 빠지다.x: The event we worked so hard on got canceled, and I felt totally deflated.
맥이 빠지다.e: Literally 'one's pulse drains away' — energy suddenly gone.
맥이 빠지다.t: 맥 빠지는 소리 = a remark that takes the wind out of your sails.

실효성.ex: 전문가들은 그 정책의 실효성을 의심하고 있어요.
실효성.x: Experts doubt how effective the policy will actually be.
실효성.e: Literally 'real effect quality' — does it work in practice, not just on paper?
실효성.t: A news favorite: 실효성 있는 대책 'measures that actually work', 실효성이 떨어지다 'to lack real effect'.

장교.ex: 그는 육군 장교로 이십 년 동안 근무했습니다.
장교.x: He served as an army officer for twenty years.
장교.e: 장 'general' plus 교 'field-grade officer' — commissioned officers as a class, as opposed to enlisted ranks.

상신하다.m: to submit to a superior (for approval), to report up
상신하다.x: I submitted the business trip plan to the team leader for approval.
상신하다.e: Literally 'report upward' — used in office approval systems.
상신하다.t: In Korean offices, 결재를 상신하다 means sending a document up the chain for sign-off.

공소시효.ex: 그 사건은 공소시효가 이미 지나서 처벌할 수 없어요.
공소시효.x: The statute of limitations on that case has already run out, so no one can be punished.

병원체.ex: 바이러스와 세균은 질병을 일으키는 대표적인 병원체입니다.
병원체.x: Viruses and bacteria are typical pathogens that cause disease.
병원체.e: Literally 'the body that is the origin of disease'.

각주.ex: 인용한 내용은 반드시 각주로 출처를 밝혀야 해요.
각주.x: For quoted content, you must give the source in a footnote.
각주.e: Literally 'foot note' — a note at the foot of the page.

데뷔작.ex: 이 영화는 감독의 데뷔작이라고 믿기 어려울 만큼 훌륭해요.
데뷔작.x: This movie is so good it's hard to believe it's the director's debut.

필유곡절.m: there must be a reason behind it
필유곡절.ex: 그가 갑자기 그만둔 데에는 필유곡절이 있을 거예요.
필유곡절.x: There must be some reason why he suddenly quit.
필유곡절.e: Literally 'there must be twists and turns' behind it.
필유곡절.t: 곡절 is common on its own too, as in 우여곡절 'ups and downs'.

당위.ex: 환경 보호는 선택이 아니라 당위의 문제입니다.
당위.x: Protecting the environment isn't a choice but a matter of necessity.

식자우환.m: knowledge brings worry; ignorance is bliss
식자우환.ex: 식자우환이라더니 너무 많이 알아서 오히려 걱정이 많아요.
식자우환.x: Knowledge is a burden, they say; knowing too much just makes me worry more.
식자우환.e: Literally 'knowing letters brings worry and trouble'.
